title: Sell bottled water locally
summary: Packaged drinking water for the Eswatini market

steps.title: Identify the correct product standard
steps.detail: Packaged drinking water is covered by SZNS 042. Confirm the exact product type (still, sparkling, mineral).

steps.title: Buy and apply the standard
steps.detail: Obtain SZNS 042 and ensure your water meets the chemical, microbiological and labelling requirements.

action.label: Buy SZNS 042
action.reason: Buying a standard requires an account so we can license the download to you.

steps.title: Arrange product testing
steps.detail: Submit samples to an accredited laboratory for the required chemical and microbiological tests.

action.label: Book lab testing
action.reason: Booking creates a tracked request under your account.

steps.title: Apply for product certification
steps.detail: Once test results are ready, apply for the product certification mark so you can sell legally.

action.label: Apply for certification
action.reason: Applying creates a tracked case under your account.
